WF-03 Step 00: Git Setup for GitHub issue #406 (ISS-0601-LEAK-001)

Issue: Memory leak in src/definition/store.zig parseGraphJson - node IDs allocated via allocator.dupe(u8, n.id) without matching free.

Execute fn:git-setup protocol from docs/agents/protocols/GIT_SETUP.md:
1. Ensure on main branch with clean state
2. Pull latest from origin
3. Create feature branch: feature/WF03-gh406-20260803
4. Push feature branch to origin
5. Verify branch exists on GitHub

Return PASS only when feature branch exists on GitHub and local repo is on that branch.
acceptance_criteria: git status shows clean working tree
gh repo view shows feature branch exists on GitHub

result.summary: Git setup completed: feature branch feature/WF03-gh406-20260803 created and pushed to GitHub
